report.tagline: An online-only insurance company that sells car, bike, health and life cover through its app, and tries to make claims fast and painless.
report.simpleSummary: Acko is an insurance company with no branches and no agents. You buy car or health insurance on its app in a few minutes, usually cheaper than others because it saves on agent commissions. When your car gets dented, you file the claim in the app, and Acko may pick up the car, repair it and drop it back. Its whole bet is that a good claims experience makes people stay.

overview.whatItDoes: Acko is a licensed general insurer that also has a life insurance arm. It sells car, bike, health, travel and life policies directly online, and also embeds small insurance products in partner apps like travel and e-commerce sites. Because it has no agents, it can price policies lower. It builds its own claims tools, such as app-based car inspections and pickup-and-drop repairs.
howItWorks: You enter your car number or health details in the Acko app or site.
Acko shows a price instantly, often lower than rivals, because it pays no agent commission.
You pay and the policy is issued in minutes.
To claim, you upload photos or video in the app; small claims can be approved quickly.
For cars, Acko can pick up the car, repair it at a partner garage and return it.
Acko also sells tiny policies inside partner apps, like trip cancellation cover when booking a flight.
overview.valueProposition: Cheaper insurance bought in minutes, with fast app-based claims and no agent calling you.

businessModel.summary: Acko is the insurer, so it keeps the premium and pays claims. It makes money if premiums plus investment income are more than claims and running costs. It saves money by not paying agents, and spends it on tech, marketing and claims.

revenueStreams.detail: Car and bike cover, the biggest line.
Interest on premiums held before claims are paid; ₹265 crore in FY26.
Pure protection term plans through Acko Life.

businessModel.pricing: Prices shown instantly on the site based on vehicle, age and cover. Car insurance often starts at a few thousand rupees a year; health plans vary by age and city.
costDrivers: Claims paid (₹1,271 crore net in FY26)
Tech and staff (operating expenses ₹623 crore in FY26)
businessModel.unitEconomics: Think of ₹100 of premium earned. In FY26 Acko paid about ₹66 in claims and about ₹32 in running costs. That leaves only ₹1 to ₹2 of underwriting profit. Investment income on held premiums tipped the year into profit. So Acko's survival depends on keeping the claims ratio low and cutting costs, while still paying claims fast. These figures are worked from reported totals.

howTheyGetUsers: Acko Drive for new car buyers
whatBringsUsersBack: Lower renewal price with no-claim bonus
growth.moat: Direct relationship with customers, its own claims tech and repair network, and pricing data from crores of policies. Old insurers have agent networks they can't easily drop, so they struggle to match Acko's price.

pmLessons: In insurance, the claim is the product. Design it first.
Cutting out middlemen lowers price, but you then pay to find customers yourself.
In regulated businesses, a strong product can still be slowed by rules on costs.
Small embedded products bring users cheaply but need a path to bigger ones.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you improve Acko's health claims experience?
interviewQuestions.hint: Map the claim flow, find delays and rejections, propose document checks, clear deductions and status updates. Track days to settle and complaints.

interviewQuestions.question: Is direct-only sales right for Acko?
interviewQuestions.hint: Compare cost savings to marketing cost. Consider partners for reach.

interviewQuestions.question: What is Acko's north star metric?
interviewQuestions.hint: Claims settled fast and fairly. Explain why it beats premium growth.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you grow in tier-2 cities?
interviewQuestions.hint: Garage partners, vernacular app, local marketing, measure claims experience.

interviewQuestions.question: How should Acko stay within IRDAI expense limits?
interviewQuestions.hint: Cut marketing cost, use automation, focus on renewals.
